decisions.rationale: Pelipper sets Drizzle for Mega Swampert's Swift Swim. Raichu and Basculegion back up in the rear to handle speed control, Lightning Rod, and heavy offense.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 lead Pelipper + Swampert, back Basculegion + Raichu. Establish rain immediately and leverage Swift Swim.

decisions.rationale: Lead Rotom-Mow (Levitate immune to Ground, resists Water/Hurricane, Leaf Storm 4x OHKO Swampert) + Empoleon (resists Water/Hurricane, pivots). Back Slowbro (Trick Room flips Swift Swim) and Mega Gengar (Shadow Tag trap, Shadow Ball 2x Basculegion, Perish Song). Blunts rain spam and removes the Swift Swim threat immediately.
decisions.notebook: Opponent 'Stamina Checkers' rain team: Pelipper (Drizzle), Swampert-Mega (Swift Swim), Basculegion (Choice Scarf Adaptability), Archaludon, Raichu, Tsareena. Verified matchups: Leaf Storm 4x Swampert; Ice Beam neutral Pelipper but Empoleon resists Hurricane via Steel; Hurricane neutral Rotom-Mow; Shadow Ball 2x Basculegion. Plan vs this team: bring Rotom-Mow (Levitate/Sitrus, Leaf Storm OHKO Swampert, Will-O-Wisp), Empoleon (Water/Steel wall), Slowbro (Trick Room speed flip), Mega Gengar (Shadow Tag + Perish Song + Ghost damage). Use Trick Room to negate Swift Swim sweepers.

selection: Earthquake (all adjacent, including ally Pelipper) + Mega Evolve
decisions.rationale: Protect Pelipper to shield it from Rotom-Mow's potential Thunderbolt or Leaf Storm, while Mega Evolving Swampert and using Earthquake to hit both foes hard (especially super-effective on Empoleon, while Rotom-Mow is immune to Ground). Swampert's Mega Evolution grants Swift Swim in rain.
Swampert fainted last turn, so we must replace it. Basculegion enters in rain with Choice Scarf and Adaptability to pressure Rotom-Mow and Slowbro. Pelipper stays in to maintain rain.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Lead Pelipper + Mega Swampert against Rotom-Mow + Slowbro. Swampert was KOed by Rotom-Mow Leaf Storm. Bring in Basculegion in back. Rain is up via Drizzle and Damp Rock.

decisions.rationale: Leaf Storm 4x OHKOs Swampert (sweeper removed even if it Mega Evolves). Rotom-Mow is Ground-immune, so Swampert's EQ only hits Slowbro (17.8-56.5%, safe) after Empoleon switches in. This sets up Trick Room next turn and keeps Empoleon off the 2x EQ line. Protecting Empoleon would waste the spread EQ and funnel a 2x Ice Punch onto Rotom-Mow, so switching is safer.
decisions.notebook: Opponent 'Stamina Checkers' rain team: Drizzle Pelipper, Swampert-Mega Swift Swim, Basculegion Choice Scarf Adaptability, Archaludon Stamina, Raichu LightningRod FocusSash, Tsareena QueenlyMajesty. Verified: Rotom-Mow Leaf Storm 4x OHKO Swampert (also if Mega, HP base unchanged); Thunderbolt 4x OHKO Pelipper; Rotom-Mow immune to Ground (Levitate) so Swampert EQ never hits it. Swampert-Mega EQ: 44-143% Empoleon (risky 2x), 17.8-56.5% Slowbro (safe). Pelipper Hurricane 1x Rotom-Mow (32-75%), 0.5x Empoleon (Steel). Ice Beam 1x Pelipper. Shadow Ball 2x Basculegion. Plan: Rotom-Mow (Leaf Storm Swampert, Will-O-Wisp), Empoleon (Water/Steel wall), Slowbro (Trick Room vs Swift Swim/Scarf), Mega Gengar (Shadow Tag + Perish Song). Avoid Protecting Empoleon vs Swampert (funnels Ice Punch onto Rotom-Mow).

decisions.rationale: Pelipper targets Rotom-Mow with Hurricane while Choice Scarf Basculegion uses Last Respects on Slowbro for super-effective damage, taking advantage of Basculegion's speed and adaptability.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Swampert lost to Rotom-Mow Leaf Storm T1. Basculegion and Pelipper active in rain.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Thunderbolt is 4x on Pelipper (86-172% even at -2 SpA), very likely OHKOing the rain setter and removing Hurricane pressure. Slowbro Protects because Basculegion's Last Respects is really 100 BP (engine prints base 50) = ~63-95% on Slowbro, which likely KOs it at 79%; Protect blocks their best line, keeps my Trick Room setter alive, and costs nothing since Slowbro's Scald is 0.5x on both foes. Slowbro also gains Leftovers chip.
decisions.notebook:
Opp 'Stamina Checkers' rain: Pelipper (Drizzle/DampRock/Modest: RainDance, Hurricane, HydroPump, Protect), Swampert-Mega (KO'd G1 by Leaf Storm), Basculegion (ChoiceScarf, Adaptability, Adamant: WaveCrash, LastRespects, FlipTurn, AquaJet), plus exactly one of Raichu (Sash/LightningRod/FakeOut/Encore), Archaludon (Stamina/Sitrus), Tsareena (QueenlyMajesty - blocks my priority).

VERIFIED CALCS (L50, rain):
- Rotom-Mow TBolt at -2 SpA -> Pelipper 86-172% (4x). Unboosted TBolt = clean OHKO.
- Rotom Leaf Storm -2 -> Basculegion 45-81%.
- IMPORTANT: estimate_damage prints Last Respects at BP 50 base; real BP = 50*(1+their faints). DOUBLE the number per faint. At 1 faint: ~63-95% Slowbro, ~56-84% Rotom-Mow. Grows as I KO their mons.
- Basculegion WaveCrash -> Rotom 50-73%; Pelipper Hurricane -> Rotom 40-60% (100% acc in rain).
- Empoleon (Water/Steel) takes Water at 0.25x = hard Basculegion wall vs WaveCrash/AquaJet/FlipTurn; LastRespects only 1x on it.
- Rotom immune to Ground (Levitate).

PLAN: Empoleon is the Basculegion answer. Never send Gengar-Mega into Basculegion (LastRespects 2x = OHKO); save Mega Gengar Shadow Tag/PerishSong for endgame vs non-Basculegion or after it's locked into a Water move. Trick Room only with Slowbro healthy and safe (Slowbro 50 spe, Empoleon 80 benefit; Gengar-Mega 165+ hates TR). Rotom SpA drops persist - switch out to reset if Leaf Storm spammed. Watch Raichu LightningRod redirecting my Thunderbolt.

decisions.rationale: Raichu targets Slowbro with Thunderbolt to pressure its remaining 85% HP (or clean if damaged), and Basculegion uses Last Respects into Slowbro to secure maximum damage on the field while locked into Choice Scarf Last Respects.
decisions.notebook: Rotom-Mow has Leaf Storm and Thunderbolt. Slowbro has Protect and Regenerator. Basculegion is Choice-locked into Last Respects.

decisions.rationale: Basculegion is Choice-locked into Last Respects (150 BP Adaptability, 2x on Slowbro = OHKO). Switch Slowbro to Empoleon so the hit lands at 1x (Empoleon survives ~47-70%). Rotom Protects to dodge Raichu FakeOut flinch and chip, setting up a clean turn 4. Opponent has no bench (Pelipper/Swampert fainted), so we win the attrition vs locked Basculegion + Sash Raichu.
decisions.notebook: Opp 'Stamina Checkers' rain team brought 4: Pelipper (Drizzle/DampRock/Modest, fainted G1), Swampert-Mega (fainted G1 to Leaf Storm), Basculegion (ChoiceScarf/Adaptability/Adamant: WaveCrash, LastRespects, FlipTurn, AquaJet; G1 locked LastRespects), Raichu (FocusSash/LightningRod/Timid: FakeOut, VoltSwitch, Thunderbolt, Encore). Archaludon & Tsareena NOT brought G1. Basculegion LastRespects BP=50*(1+faints); 2 faints=150, 2x on Psychic/Slowbro, 1x on Empoleon/Rotom, 2x on Gengar. LightningRod redirects all my Electric to Raichu. Empoleon is Basculegion wall (Water 0.25x, Ghost 1x). Never Mega Gengar into Basculegion (LastRespects 2x OHKO). Rotom SpA drops persist (-2 now); switch to reset. Trick Room only with Slowbro safe.

decisions.rationale: Rotom menu limited to Pass/Forfeit. Switch Slowbro: it survives Basculegion's locked Last Respects (150BP, 2x Ghost on Psychic ≈138 dmg vs ~147 HP) thanks to bulk; Gengar would be OHKO'd by 2x Ghost. Slowbro then can Slack Off/Regenerator and set Trick Room next turn.

Slowbro survives one LastRespects(~138<147HP); Gengar OHKO'd by it. Rotom SpA -2 persists; switch to reset. Trick Room only with Slowbro safe. Never Mega Gengar vs Basculegion.

decisions.rationale: Raichu targets Slowbro with Thunderbolt to deal heavy damage, while Choice-locked Basculegion uses Last Respects into Slowbro for super-effective damage. Rotom-Mow resisted Electric moves, and Slowbro is vulnerable.

Basculegion is choice-locked into Last Respects (150 BP, 2x on Slowbro, OHKO-range on both my mons). Slowbro Protects (100% safe after switch reset) to block it and Raichu's Thunderbolt. Rotom-Mow Leaf Storms Basculegion to chip it (~92-123) toward a Gengar Shadow Ball KO next turn; Rotom's SpA is already crippled (-2) and it is the likely target anyway, so attacking beats a 50%-rate Protect.

Plan: chip Basculegion with Rotom Leaf Storm (~92-123) then Gengar Mega Shadow Ball (~71-84) to KO. Never Mega Gengar vs Basculegion (dies to Last Respects 2x). Trick Room only when Slowbro safe. Rotom SpA -2 persists; switch to reset. Slowbro Protect safe (reset by switch).

decisions.rationale: Slowbro used Protect on turn 4, so it cannot protect this turn and takes super-effective Thunderbolt from Raichu. Basculegion is locked into Last Respects, which hits Slowbro for super-effective damage. Rotom-Mow is at -4 Spa and resists electric/ghost, so focusing Slowbro is safest.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Rotom Leaf Storm KOs 28% Basculegion (did 72% at SpA-4 last turn, 90% acc). Slowbro Protect blocks Last Respects (2x Ghost) and Raichu Thunderbolt; if Raichu FakeOut flinches Slowbro we still have Rotom+Gengar vs lone Raichu. Switching Slowbro only redirects the Ghost hit to Gengar (OHKO). Best EV: KO Basculegion, protect Slowbro.

decisions.notebook: Basculegion fainted. Raichu remains. Foe has Gengar and Rotom-Mow (-6 SpA).

decisions.rationale: 2v1: only Raichu left (FocusSash, no bench). Rotom Leaf Storm chips 13-32%; Mega Gengar Sludge Bomb (90BP STAB, 222 SpA) hits 46.7-109.6% — high rolls trigger sash (Raichu 1HP) then Rotom finishes turn 6, else turn 7. Sash only saves at full HP, so two hits in one turn can KO. Mega adds SpA+Shadow Tag; speed unchanged (178, ties Raichu at 178). Raichu can't KO us (max 74% Gengar, 14% Rotom). Secure win.
decisions.notebook: Opp 'Stamina Checkers' rain: Pelipper(Drizzle/DampRock/Modest: RainDance,Hurricane,HydroPump,Protect), Swampert-Mega(Adamant: EQ,Waterfall,IcePunch,Protect), Basculegion(ChoiceScarf/Adaptability/Adamant: WaveCrash,LastRespects,FlipTurn,AquaJet; locked LastRespects), Raichu(FocusSash/LightningRod/Timid: FakeOut,VoltSwitch,Thunderbolt,Encore). Archaludon(Sitrus/Stamina/Modest: ElectroShot,FlashCannon,DracoMeteor,Protect) & Tsareena(MiracleSeed/QueenlyMajesty/Adamant: PowerWhip,TripleAxel,Uturn,Protect) benched G1. LastRespects=50*(1+faints); 2 faints=150, 2x Psychic/Ghost, 1x Rotom. LightningRod redirects my Electric to Raichu. Raichu FakeOut flinch beats Protect (only turn it enters). Gengar-Mega base Speed 130 (same as base) in this sim: Mega gives SpA 222 + Shadow Tag but NO speed gain vs base 178; Raichu Timid speed 143-178 so ties at 178. Rotom SpA -2/Leaf Storm; no bench to reset. Plan: KO Basculegion w/ Rotom Leaf Storm, clean Raichu w/ Gengar; never Mega Gengar vs Basculegion (dies to LastRespects 2x). Trick Room only when Slowbro safe.

reflections.summary: The loss occurred because Swampert was instantly eliminated by Rotom-Mow's super-effective Leaf Storm on turn 1, and Rotom's Levitate immunity completely neutralized Swampert's Earthquake. Furthermore, relying heavily on Choice-scarf Basculegion's Last Respects fell straight into the opponent's Protect cycling and Slowbro's defensive capabilities.
reflections.adjustment: Bring Raichu or alternative anti-Grass/redirection options instead of Swampert to better handle Rotom-Mow and Slowbro without relying on an earthquake-immune target or vulnerable physical spam.
reflections.notebook: Opponent brings Rotom-Mow (Levitate, Leaf Storm, Sitrus Berry), Slowbro (Regenerator, Protect, Leftovers), Empoleon, and Gengar-Mega. Rotom-Mow heavily targets water types with Leaf Storm and utilizes Protect well.

reflections.summary: Won by leading Rotom-Mow Leaf Storm to OHKO Swampert-Mega (4x Grass weak) and Thunderbolt to kill Pelipper, then using Slowbro Protect to stall Basculegion while Rotom weakened it, and late Gengar-Mega Sludge Bomb + Leaf Storm cleaned Raichu. Team preview (Rotom, Slowbro, Empoleon, Gengar-Mega) suited; delaying Gengar Mega avoided Last Respects KO.
reflections.adjustment: Avoid switching Empoleon into Raichu's Thunderbolt (super-effective KO); keep it benched or only against non-Electric. Use Rotom Thunderbolt over repeated Leaf Storm to prevent SpA drops, and lead Slowbro+Rotom more safely.
reflections.notebook: Opp lead Pelipper(Drizzle)+Swampert-Mega turn1, Pelipper Protect, Swampert Mega. Basculegion ChoiceScarf locked LastRespects (scales 50*(1+faints); 150 at 2 faints) after switch; Raichu LightningRod redirects Electric, Timid, FocusSash, FakeOut flinch beats Protect on entry. Archaludon/Tsareena benched G1. Gengar-Mega speed ties Raichu Timid @178; safe to Mega only after Basculegion faints (avoids Ghost LastRespects). Rotom-Mow Leaf Storm 4x KO Swampert but SpA -2 per use, no reset. Plan: lead Rotom+Slowbro, Leaf Storm Swampert, Thunderbolt Pelipper, Protect cycle vs Basculegion, Mega Gengar cleanup. Avoid Empoleon vs Raichu (Water weak to Electric). Next game expect possible Archaludon (Stamina/ElectroShot) or Tsareena; keep Grass/Electric coverage.
